title: Gremlins 3
overview: The third installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: PAYNEKILLER
overview: Years after the murder of his wife, retired detective Max Payne is pulled back into a case he never truly left behind. When a series of new killings begins to mirror the past, what once seemed like a closed investigation starts to reveal cracks, pointing toward something that was long hidden. As Max investigates, he finds himself stepping outside the law again, uncovering a big secret regarding his own tragedy—while a mysterious individual moves in and out of his path, making it harder to tell who can be trusted.

title: The Tennis Menace Two
overview: When her father dies after challenging a divine being called "The Tennis God" to a table tennis match, Kat finally gets the chance to prove to everyone that she's the best. All she has to do is beat The Tennis God. How hard can it be?

title: The Housemaid's Secret
overview: Millie Calloway takes a job keeping house for a woman she's never allowed to see — only to discover the truth behind the locked door that threatens to expose secrets far darker than her own.

title: The Eight Saga:N.E.S.T.Project
overview: After a solar flare causes society's collapse, a new world emerges under the control of the N.E.S.T organisation, where the illusion of freedom masks a sinister reality.

title: S/H/V
overview: Four students, who make money by putting stolen school items online, are hired to steal a VHS tape from their Physical Education Teacher’s Office. However, things take a turn for the worse, when they find dozens of tapes, and being kids, they dare each other to partake in watching them.

title: No screws are missing
overview: Rubem leads a mediocre and systematic life until the inconvenience of a haunting puts his way of life and the world he lives in to the test.

title: Deathsman
overview: Percy Thompson (a Relocator for the Time Investigation Corporation) finds more than he bargained for when searching for his target.

title: X502C
overview: Set in an unknown space and time, a hyperconnected world dominated by technological dogmas, wireless cities and near total collapse, where there are no differences between human and machine, Thom will search for answers in his own history, hoping to preserve his remaining humanity.

title: Without a Trace
overview: A criminal on the run attempts to break into a house for hiding. He realizes his escape will be far more difficult than originally planned.

title: Tafers Code
overview: Tafers Code follows five teenagers at the T.A.F. language school in Itaquaquecetuba, guided by the charismatic Teacher Gilmar. Each episode explores the unique challenges and strengths of the students as they discover how learning English can transform their lives. With humor, emotion, and a touch of documentary style, the series culminates in a final project that inspires not only the characters but everyone to take the first step toward a brighter future through language learning.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Behemoth!
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: when clouds return home
overview: As twilight deepens, memory, scent, and silence drift through the air— where clouds, birds, and feelings quietly return home.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Summer's End
overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

title: Ziggy's Show: The Curse of Mariachi Bondage
original_title: El Show de Ziggy: La Maldición del Mariachi Bondage
overview: Ziggy, a rising influencer, is trying to increase her number of followers on social media by awakening the curse of an old song. Now a gloomy mariachi who makes people dance until they die is chasing Ziggy until he fulfills her dream of making her viral.

title: Vocabulary
overview: Andy, a young chunky Chinese newcomer, arrives in London’s gay scene full of wonderful dreams. What he finds instead: somewhat racist Grindr bios, slang he can’t decipher (“bog roll”), and rules no dictionary can teach. Over three sex/dates, he stumbles through the unspoken vocabulary of sex, love, and belonging.

title: Purple Roots
overview: An unnamed man descends from his garden into a series of strange and increasingly disturbing spaces, where a pale figure known as the Beak appears without warning. As reality begins to unravel, he encounters creatures of evil, a motionless woman, something concealed within a sealed black box, and a disturbing presence beneath the surface.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: The Wonka of Worcester
overview: A daughter inherits a century-old chocolate shop and its fading legacy

title: Gaetjens
overview: A movie-essay about the soccer player Joe Gaetjens, the first Haitian player to score a goal in the World Cup in the iconic match between England and U.S.

title: Day Ones
overview: On a trip to his hometown, Quail Feather’s son goes missing. In order to find him, he must reconnect with the only ones he can trust with the task… his DAY ONES.

title: Mallory
overview: An original psychological horror short film where a group of cousins take a hallucinogenic drug, but one of them experiences a horrific trip that resurrects the memory that haunts her most.

title: DANTES INFERNO
overview: Dante's Inferno unfolds in the days and weeks before the events of The Boiling Frog, tracing how Coral and Jayden were dragged into the room for the first time. We see the moment their imprisonment begins, the strange dynamics of their early friendship, and the slow erosion of hope as the walls close in. The film dives into insanity, desperate measures, hopelessness, and isolation, building an eerie sense that the room itself is already shaping their fate long before The Boiling Frog begins.

title: Two Chapter Blue Dog
overview: When a thief kills an old grandma and her dog, the three find themselves in a blue room, waiting for something to happen.

title: 70 Years of 7
overview: A very special TV event packed full of your favourite memories, rare archival footage, never before seen bloopers, personal reflections and many surprises.

title: Loved One
overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

title: The Iris Protocol
overview: For years, Iris believed the surface was unsafe. But when she leaves the safety of her bunker, she unearths a reality far more twisted than she imagined—crafted by the man who raised her.

title: Niceland
overview: An elderly pop star seeking a calmer life away from fame arrives in Niceland, a gloomy tropical town, to perform what may be his last show.

title: A Second Chance Christmas
overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Maybe We Should
overview: Determined to bring hope to their rural Pennsylvania community, a couple embark on an ambitious mission to establish a revolutionary therapy center for children with special needs.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: The Scam Artisan
overview: Day by day, sharp and manipulative Jordon Teaspoon sells modern or as some say: "scam" art to his wealthy, high paying clients. Teaspoon's business is booming as usual, until an old client resurfaces threatening the existence of the phony life Jordon has built.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Same Guy
overview: Five Guys had his heart. Michael Jackson had his feet.

title: Toxic Moon
overview: Set in a mid-90s Pine Barrens town in New Jersey, Toxic Moon follows zine writer Scuz Lanchester as she investigates a string of murderous hit-and-runs and a mysterious ooze infecting the woods, wreaking genetic havoc on every creature it touches. Lo-fi monstrosities, trash synths, bloody leather, killer cars, woundfog, slimerats and vampire bats: Toxic Moon is a rotten feast for the senses, entirely captured on VHS-C.

title: Jacky
overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Devil's Disciple: The Night Stalker
overview: A relentless, killer-POV descent into the mind of Richard Ramirez as he stalks 1980s Los Angeles, leaving terror, bloodshed, and belief-driven brutality in his wake.

title: Burned Edges
overview: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Uncovering Duke Gawthorpe
overview: After being contacted by documentarians, aristocrat Duke Gawthorpe loses his lucky antique Kazoo. He must go on a mission to try and find it before all hope is lost.

title: Check
overview: On the eve of a military deployment, two old friends meet for dinner.

title: The Automotive Dead
overview: Three guys are working away in the autoshop on a classic car when things take a turn... The car becomes possessed and will devour anyone in sight. Will Paul and George survive, or will they be run down by THE AUTOMOTIVE DEAD!!!

title: Stone Glass Metal
overview: Capturing the modern and ancient architecture of Spain with a 2001 camcorder.

title: Four Days In June
overview: A Midwest arts festival brings 60,000 people together for four days of music, food, and creativity, revealing how shared experiences can create rare common ground in a divided world.

title: The Actor
overview: A young actor attempts to finish their self audition tape. But a series of never ending interruptions sends him into an existential spiral.

title: Honey's Christmas Wish
overview: After a variety of mysterious gifts and good deeds pop up around Honey's Guesthouse, Brittany tries to uncover who amongst the visitors is behind it in this charming Christmas whodunnit.

title: Transerrante
overview: A trans, Chilean-Palestinian refugee embarks on a journey towards finding safety and belonging, while reconnecting with the roots of their intergenerational displacement.

title: Multiple Choice
overview: A group of students are killed off one by one after writing a multiple choice exam. One of them is the killer...

title: All of Us
overview: When Ruby Bridges Elementary opened in Washington State in 2020, its founding principal and staff made a radical choice: to educate every child in the same classroom, regardless of disability or support needs. Five years later, the school is seeing strong academic and social outcomes, without additional funding or staff. There was no magic fix – just a new model based on the belief that inclusion benefits everyone. All of Us is the story of a school that breaks the mold. A school that is unique, but shouldn't be.

title: Somethin' Stupid
overview: When Brynn discovers hat her ex-boyfriend will be living next door for another semester, she must muster the courage to tell him how she really feels.

title: Heart of the Lion
overview: Moving between life in London and Hong Kong, this film follows Kelvin Chan, a British-born Chinese lion dancer, as he explores how the routines and rituals of a creative, spiritual practice may provide their own sense of belonging.

title: Samhain: The Birth of Halloween
overview: Michael Londra, host of the popular travel series Ireland with Michael, takes a spine-tingling journey through Ireland to uncover Samhain, the ancient Celtic festival that gave rise to Halloween. Blending rich history, haunting folklore, and modern traditions, the film reveals the origins of a holiday now celebrated in many parts of the world.

title: One Knight
overview: After traveling to Gotham City, Superman witnesses the brutal tactics of Batman as he takes down the unlawful thief known as Magpie. Based on "One Night in Gotham City" by John Byrne

title: Believers
overview: A ragtag amateur cricket team from the UK tours The Gambia to face a national side far beyond their level. As losses mount and bonds deepen, they discover what the game truly means to them.

title: Reform Zara
overview: John Galliano’s process of reworking garments for Zara unfolds alongside theatrical tableaux suspended between past and future. Intimate conversations and observations of dressmaking reveal how a pocket alters posture, an opening changes movement, and clothing becomes character. Moving between documentary and fiction, the film explores imagination, memory and authorship through the transformation of familiar forms.

title: CAPTURED
overview: Andy, a stressed and obsessive wildlife photographer desperate for a competition-winning shot, sets out alone into the woods where his anxiety, lack of medication, and mounting frustration blur the line between ambition and self-destruction.

title: Escape at Alcatraz
overview: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Red Velvet
overview: After the death of her father, a young woman takes over the family baking business. One day, a pretty stranger visits her cupcake stall, and she begins to believe that love is something she must have. Something she must be consumed by.

title: Loretta Robinson:An American Dream
overview: Joh'Vonnie Monroe:An American Dream is a film of how Joh'Vonnie Monroe got started,what achievements and records she has shattered and the barriers she broke for all black girls and woman to play The Good Witch Of The South she first gained the role in the film The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's on TMDB for this she has received praise for her performance as the iconic chachter even being called The Next EGOT and being compared to Billie Burke. Her debut music album Joh'Vonnie Monroe Introduces The Good Witch Of the South Features as the film's soundtrack.

title: FULL MAJOR PSYCHOSIS
overview: A young man wishes to finish writing his script, but his father has grown tired of him wasting his time and takes matters into his own hands.

title: Their Eyes of God
overview: A psychedelic journey into the mind of a man, and the faces of those he remembers.

title: Barn Family
overview: It takes a family to do a horse show!

title: Remember That Time
overview: In an unprecedented cinematic experiment, five strangers, led by an enigmatic facilitator enter a Nordic LARP (Live Action Role Play), about grief, love, and loss, where the line between performance and reality begins to dissolve.

title: a scene of fallen leaves
overview: a man reminisces over a lost love

title: Dùthchas: Our Underwater Forests
overview: An animated documentary exploring the parallel loss of marine biodiversity and Gaelic culture and language in Scotland. Six interviews with researchers and practitioners,explore marine ecosystems, capitalism, and rewilding alongside a fully animated visual story. The hand-painted animation is based on underwater sketches, giving it a dreamlike yet accurate look.

title: Invite the Devil to Come and Play
original_title: Invite the Devil to Come and Play
overview: Oliver is an experimental musician struggling for recognition between his duties at home and at work. Spending more and more time on his strange music, he seems to have discovered an unexpected listener, one who may have a devilish motive.

title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
overview: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

title: The Christmas Heartbeat
overview: Following sudden cardiac arrest, Julia Winters is forced back to her Nashville hometown, where Christmas never fades and old wounds still linger. To truly move forward, she must confront the past she thought she’d left behind—and the future she never saw coming.

title: Content
overview: Nia turns missing women into headlines and killers into targets. But when a dangerous listener follows her on a remote getaway, she becomes the story.

title: Apnea
overview: A sleep-deprived woman sets up a camcorder to record herself at night, hoping to prove something is visiting her, only to capture her own slow suffocation at the hands of an unknown entity.

title: The reflection
overview: A young actress receives news that forces her to confront not only rejection but also a version of herself that seems to know all too well exactly what she is going through.

title: Chimp Outbreak
overview: An aggressive chimp has escaped confinement and creates a path of death and destruction.

title: Early Human Media
overview: At the end of their second date, Joaquin accepts Misty’s invitation up to her apartment, but the night takes a turn when her eccentric brother subjects him to a surreal trial that leaves him questioning reality and love.

title: Ann Arbor After Asphyxia
overview: The summer my dad died, I rediscovered the last birthday card he ever wrote for me.

title: Changed Forever
overview: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

title: NOSEBLEED
overview: When unresolved trauma resurfaces, the restless Maya is forced to confront her spiraling nature, both that of victim and that of perpetrator.  NOSEBLEED is a raw, semi-autobiographical dance film in which the border between reality and fiction blurs in a provocative exploration of desire and power.

title: Good Pasture
overview: On the night of a terrible storm, a lonely priest is visited in his church by a mysterious visitor.

title: The Vampires of New Orleans
overview: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

title: Unsavory Elements
overview: Boys' night out to an Asian brothel becomes a bloody fight for survival.

title: Wolpie of the Woods
overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Duck Duck Goose
overview: While working as children’s entertainers to supplement their slow-moving acting careers, best friends Jack and Bill decide to rob a house during a 9-year-old’s birthday party. As they attempt to carry out the plan without drawing attention, tensions rise and their friendship is put under strain.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Enclosure
overview: Enclosure is set within a decaying facility that was once designed for replication—a destination where tourists could temporarily inhabit the lives of others. Each year, on Founding Day, Donors return to either renew or terminate their doubles, known as Cherubs, through a ritual intended to sever the connection between original and copy.  Mercy, a starlet who lent her likeness to the programme, arrives to terminate her contract. Instead, the process begins to collapse the distance between them, and what was designed as a clear division becomes porous and unstable.

title: Cop This
overview: It's Grand Final Day and in a suburban police station about to be replaced by an AI 'Terminal', the two remaining cops (Nicolette Minster and Ray O'Leary) are tasked with babysitting a drug dealer for 24 hours.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
original_title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

title: In Vivid Memory, Come Again
overview: On her 21st birthday, a heartbroken teenage girl revisits the bittersweet moments of her previous relationship before finally letting go of the past.

title: The Importance of Trans Elders
overview: Jack Gray and Kitty Cane Harry discuss their experiences as older transgender individuals and the struggles they faced growing up and accepting themselves in a world that believed their identities weren't valid.

title: Antonio's Road
overview: It's 1929. Antonio immigrates from Italy to become a success as an artist in America. Mary leaves Ireland to make a better life for her child. Their paths cross again and again as their dreams are crushed. It will take the next generation to make it in America.

title: Dasher
overview: A down-and-out food delivery driver, Josh, and a fiery restaurant worker, Kayla, team up for a comedic and chaotic night of deliveries. Demanding customers, stolen sushi, and the festive mayhem on Christmas Eve push some life back into their lives and get them to dream just a bit more. Set in urban Honolulu, DASHER is a local take on what’s likely a nationwide story for young people living the gig economy – where working long hours just to get by discourages any life beyond the next gig.

title: Aurora Ave: Sunrise to Sunset
overview: This documentary captures Seattle’s infamous Aurora Avenue from morning to night.

title: Posthumous
overview: After returning to her childhood home, Zoe discovers a mysterious videotape that unravels everything she thought she knew about her birth and her mother's death, awakening an unimaginable horror.

title: Strange Spirits
overview: In a haunted roadside bar run by the mysterious Ghoulian Madman, a series of twisted horror stories unfold, from cursed video games and alien body snatchers to killer clowns and supernatural nightmares, proving every spirit has a story.

title: Fly Train
overview: Like a bee tracing the windows of an endless train, thoughts on an ordinary journey drift between scenery and fragmented memories. Through experimental shadow play, everyday silhouettes transform into the surreal, slipping into a hypnotic stream of consciousness. As the wheels turn, the search for memory's meaning fades, leaving us to immerse ourselves in the ephemeral, flickering flow of frames.

title: Inside Kent's Drag Bubble
overview: A colorful portrait of Kent Ohio's local drag scene, following performers as they balance school, identity, and art.

title: Not Your Average Girl
overview: Not Your Average Girl is a journey through survival and becoming—a visual memoir that dares to tell the story behind the spotlight. From growing up in the South to standing in her power at the 2025 BET Black & Iconic Awards, Hope offers viewers a raw and intimate look at the trials, triumphs, and tenderness that shaped her. This is a love letter to every Black trans girl who’s ever been told she wouldn’t make it—and a reckoning with the systems that tried to silence her.

title: Cereal Killers
overview: A ex-detective, now turned high school principal attempts to solve a case involving 3 strange students.

title: Play House
overview: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired children’s show that begins to invade his life and threaten his chance at reconciliation.

title: Api (April, 1949)
overview: Too often, we forget what and who has come before us. Do we exist because of our corporeal forms, or have we long existed in our ancestor’s dreams and prayers?  Api (April, 1949) is a one-take recorded translation of a man’s proposal letter and firm vision of life through love. Penned after my paternal grandfather’s time in a forced labor camp during WWII, Api (April, 1949) is a reconstruction of his bid for agency during a time of oppression and destruction. Both an homage to his dreams and prayers and a critical interpretation of values and authority, this film is an interpretation of generational inheritance and reclamation.

title: Sparks
overview: Two late-20s Londoners walk home from their first date and see the exact life they will have if they pursue the sparks between them.

title: RAT KING: OUROBOROS
overview: In a dystopian reality, 50% of human beings have microplastics inside their body. This results to a number of people experiencing hearing inner voices claiming to be the microplastics gaining sentience.  A young man (Ted) affected by this phenomenon tries to make amends with the microplastic inside of him.

title: Waterman's Heritage - Oysters in St. Mary's County
original_title: Waterman's Heritage - Oysters in St. Mary's County
overview: ‘Waterman's Heritage - Oysters in St. Mary's County’ is a documentary that tells the tale of the men and women who harvest oysters throughout the Chesapeake Bay, exploring their impact on bay restoration and how this seafood staple get's on our dinner tables.  The film follows four oyster businesses throughout the county, Bay River Fishing, Wild Willy's Seafood, Loose Stones Oyster Company and Double T Oyster Ranch, each representing a unique approach to oyster harvesting and farming practices. ‘Waterman's Heritage’ aims to educate viewers about the state of the industry and above all, make you hungry to visit restaurants and seafood markets in St. Mary's County.

title: Kylgor in the Grisly Abyss
overview: Kylgor and his band of fellow survivors set out for revenge and to behead the Evil King Kath but unexpectedly plummet into the Grisly Abyss.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Metal boy
overview: A homeless man named Keith, Is suspicious about the mayor Bob, for all the changes he's done to the town. Until he finds this helmet that gives him superpowers and uses them to expose Bob's secrets.

title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
overview: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

title: The Pickleball Racket
overview: A disgraced councilwoman uncovers a pickleball conspiracy threatening her city and teams up with an unlikely group of allies to stop the town-wide tournament and save her community.

title: Designed by Preeti
overview: A courageous woman leaves her abusive husband, builds a successful career, and finds love where she least expects it.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Split
overview: A quiet young man burdened by the weight of his past spends an ordinary evening with his closest friend, but as the night unfolds, familiar moments begin to fracture into something unrecognizable. When morning arrives with a devastating revelation, he is left searching for answers within memories that refuse to stay still. A haunting psychological drama about trauma, identity, and the stories the mind tells to survive

title: Eternal
overview: Eternal is an allegorical tale about a man who, in his grief, seeks out death and the ability to see his loved one again.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: Pass the Bottle
overview: A reckless addict is taken on an unexpected journey that forces her to fight for survival.

title: Skin of Foam
overview: On a quiet night in the biggest city of Southern China, a small-town migrant carwash worker encounters a strange customer who forces him into a decision that might change his life.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: Crude Awakenings
overview: At a ruthless PR firm, an ambitious publicist takes on a notorious energy company at the promise of a promotion. As a mysterious sickness spreads throughout her firm, she must decide whether to sacrifice her morals in favour of corporate success.

title: Somero
overview: The Four Seasons - part one: Two strangers are brought together during a lock-down, in the wake of a world changing natural event.

title: Mind, Body & Soul
overview: A friendly rivalry goes from a casual game of chess to an all-out virtual kumite.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: i am not from here
overview: A three-headed Melbourne set reality film about art, dialectics, and regionality.

title: Amityverse: End Game
overview: Third and final horror anthology in the Amityverse series, featuring 10 more Amityville-themed segments.

title: Atlas King
overview: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Three Black Men
overview: Can blackness escape the violence of its origins?  Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

title: Lesbian Ditch Day
overview: Lesbian Ditch Day starts as a rom-com-y, coming-of-age tale of two high school lesbians playing hooky, but through a fourth wall break, the film reveals itself to be just another queerbaiting tragedy.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the anxiety of the city after dark. A filmmaker struggles to understand the film she is making. A Black single mother refuses the categories imposed on her. A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

title: The Showdown
overview: A young man is confronted by a vicious supernatural entity whilst attempting to retrieve some belongings from his ex-boyfriend.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: Finding Your Laughter
overview: In this deeply personal documentary, Arlieta has gone against all popular advice and quit her day job to care for her father, Milton. She has to learn how to laugh in the midst of a disease that is not very funny, using improv to affirm and validate his experiences. Inspired by her father’s own artistic career, Arlieta turns to comedy to process her emotions. It’s challenging for her and her “bonus mom” Charmaine to watch Milton decline, but they support each other and find healing through laughter.

title: Angels Pull Your Hair
overview: Angels Pull Your Hair is a narrative short about Danielle, a young Black woman grappling with the lasting impact of being raised by a mother with untreated mental illness. As Danielle struggles to make sense of her past, she’s haunted by the fear that she’s inherited her mother’s condition — a fear that takes form in the figure of a faceless sleep paralysis demon

title: Authors of the Estate
overview: In North West London, two estates take their story into their own hands, asking what if a council house can become a publishing house in this tale of ownership, creativity, and the power of community.

title: Glass Bricks
overview: Finessa Jawn — a trained dancer and life-long performer — gives us a look behind the curtain into the world of drag, walking us through the process of building a persona and embracing who you are regardless of society's expectations.

title: For Peace of Mind
overview: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

title: Ish Meets a Mermaid
overview: An Ojibwe artist named Ish finds that his paintings aren’t selling anymore, he is in debt to his gallery rep, and a local goon is lurking around his studio. When he decides to take an artist’s getaway, he meets trouble with a mysterious woman, Ziibi, who claims to be part of an underwater society that tribal mythology refers to as the people of the water, or Nibiinaabe. Ziibi brings Ish on a wild ride that ultimately leads to him finding success in the last place he ever expected — death.

title: Potato Salad
overview: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

title: Super Troopers 3
overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

title: Our Bodies Ours
overview: Our Bodies Ours is a short poetic animated film that explores the nuance and beauty of trans becoming from a diasporic lens. Leaning on the music of lyric, it reframes gender-affirming care as an intricate, intimate and meandering act. What does it take to stitch our bodies into their true and ever-changing shapes, to migrate between who we are and who we may become?

title: Feed
overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

title: Devils Lake
overview: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

title: Sonia Honey
overview: On a single, transformative day, a middle-aged fêted actress navigates the blurred lines between reel and reality, unearthing buried truths about identity, ageing, and the silent labour of care in a world that constantly rewrites her relevance.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
original_title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.

title: We Knew Her Well: Hippie Perihan
original_title: We Knew Her Well: Hippie Perihan
overview: In the late 1960s, Istanbul was the eastern gateway of the hippie trail to Kathmandu. The cheap hotels of Sultanahmet and the tables of the Pudding Shop were crowded with travelers from all over the world. Among them lived a local legend: Hippie Perihan. Having run away from Izmir at seventeen, Perihan lived her life as an experiment, in a society where a young woman's freedom to choose for herself came at a cost. Crowned "Queen of the Hippies" for the way she danced and laughed without restraint, she was found dead in a hotel room at nineteen. After her death, the press demeaned her, popular cinema rewrote her story, and a woman who claimed to speak with spirits began to speak in her name. Made entirely in a pixel-game aesthetic, this animation is a tribute to one of the most talked-about yet least-known cult female figures in Turkish history. It is also an experiment in how many times a woman's life can be rewritten in the memories of others. (Labocine)

title: Freddy’s Back
overview: “FREDDY’S BACK" stars Michael Leavy (Terrifier, STREAM) as 'Freddy Krueger' alongside Allison Pittel (Screamboat) as 'Natalie', in an original nightmare sequence that puts Leavy beneath the fedora and into full Freddy prosthetics for the first time.

title: Tapes
overview: A man gets a chance to view his memories on VHS tapes, which turns into a mind-bending experience about life, death, and memories.
